title: Vertex literal lies among its clause's three literals
statement: Let $f$ be a 3-CNF formula, let $v$ be a vertex of the conflict graph of $f$, and let $i$ be a clause index of $f$ such that the clause component of $v$ equals $i$. Then the literal named by $v$ is one of the three literals $l_1, l_2, l_3$ of the clause $f[i]$.
hypotheses_covered: v is a vertex of the conflict graph of f
i is a clause index of f
the clause index of v equals i
replaced:
If $v$ is a clique vertex with $v.c\_idx = i$, then the literal
$\mathtt{getLitAt}\,f\,v$ is one of the three literals $l_1$, $l_2$, $l_3$ of
clause $f[i]$.
